description: Fetch the actual data of an opendata.swiss / City of Zürich dataset and return matching rows. Picks the best machine-readable resource (CSV > JSON > GeoJSON; HTML landing pages, ZIP, XLSX, PDF and services are skipped and reported with their download URLs), parses it and applies search / column filters / sort / paging. Returns columns, total matched, rows, the resource used and its licence. Works with a dataset id or a direct resource_url. Run describe_dataset_columns first to learn column names and values. Examples: {id: '<dataset-id>', where: {Kanton: 'ZH'}, sort: '-Einwohner', limit: 10}; {id: '<dataset-id>', search: 'Winterthur', columns: ['Jahr','Wert']}; {resource_url: 'https://…/data.csv', where: {Jahr: '>2020'}}.

columns.description: Only return these columns (names are matched case/accent-insensitively; max 50)

format.description: Preferred resource format (overrides the CSV-first default)

id.description: Dataset ID (slug): the 'id' of a search_datasets hit

lang.description: Language for titles/descriptions: de, fr, it or en (default en; falls back to de)

limit.description: Rows to return (default 25, max 200; large rows are trimmed to fit 50 KB)

portal.description: Catalogue: 'opendata.swiss' (default, national), 'stadt-zuerich' (City of Zürich, data.stadt-zuerich.ch) or 'envidat' (WSL/ETH environmental research data: snow, glaciers, forests, biodiversity, climate)

resource.description: Optional resource selector: 0-based index from get_dataset, resource id, or part of its title. Default: best CSV > JSON > GeoJSON

resource_url.description: Alternatively, a direct https URL of a CSV/JSON/GeoJSON file (e.g. a download_url from get_dataset). May be disabled on public deployments, prefer 'id'

search.description: Case-insensitive substring matched against every field

sort.description: Sort column; prefix '-' for descending, e.g. '-Jahr'

where.description: Column filters: {column: value}. Exact (case-insensitive) match; prefix '~' for substring, '>'/'<' for numeric compare, e.g. {"Kanton": "ZH", "Jahr": ">2019"}

name: query_dataset
title: Query the rows of an open-data dataset
